One day, toward the end of summer
camp...
Okay, let's get started.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: First, we'll start with a warm-up!

text_block_list.text: Got it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Gyah!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Darn it!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
What in the world was that sound?! Are
you
okay?!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: I'm fine! I can keep goin'!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I know you're in a rush to improve. But
lemme tell
you, it hurts to look at you in
this state!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Then don't! I've... I've got dis!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: I hafta win!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
What?! This is totally unlike you,
Tamamo!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Tamamo...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Let's get started, Trainer. I need to work
harder
too!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Okay, let's take a ten minute break!

text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
At Голд Сити's request, I've been putting
her
through a course of extra-heavy
training.
However, her body is beginning
to reach its limits.
choice_data_list:
(I'd really like her to take a proper break
soon...)

text_block_list.text:
Knowing Голд Сити, she'll just reject any

suggestion that threatens to reduce her
training
time. There has to be a way to
convince her...
Ah! Found you, City! ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Wahey! ☆ What's popping?!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks rough! No surprise
coming from
little Miss Stoic.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Helios, Jordan... What's up?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You free tonight?! Let's launch some
fireworks! ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Helios brought some sparklers and stuff.
Isn't that
hilarious?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: To light up the sky!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
You're coming, right, City? We're gonna
get it
popping like literally! ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Light up the sky?! How're you going to
do that
with "sparklers and stuff"?!
You're up to
something dangerous for
sure!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh boy. I can't let them go off on their
own.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити is clearly opposed to the idea,
but she
needs the time to unwind. This
might be my
chance to convince her.

That's what I'm talking about! Then your
trainer
can be our adult supervision. ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
I'm saying we got us our responsible
adult, so now
we just need a spot. And
just when I was about to
hit up Teach!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how you handle these
two.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Bet! ☆ So, about where to do it!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
My friend who owns a private beach says
beaches
are better, but my mountain
hippie friend says
the mountains!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
So what do you think?! We're a teensy
ways from
the beach, and the mountains
sounds like a
teensy uphill trek.
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос
choice_data_list: A teensy ways to the beach.

text_block_list.text: And so...

Eyyy, City! Stop being such a drag, get
turnt up!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Can't we just chill for a minute? Then we
can get
out the sparklers or whatever.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: No can do! Hype up and re-hype!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Stop playing games and get serious! This
is a
party!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Where's the mega firework?! This
one's going
to the moon!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Ugh, Helios! Come on!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: This is hilarious. I have to take a video.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Time passes as they have their fun.

Is that all the fireworks we have?
Laaame.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Wasn't there a convenience store along
the way?
I can go check.
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'll go. Even though it's kind of a
hassle.
Trainer, you're on bag carrying
duty.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: And so...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer! Where's your energy?!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Here, grab more fireworks! Let's gooo!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: It's fiiine! Let me show you how it's done!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Pfft. Good luck stopping Helios. Oh, I
can't.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Right? Girl is built different. I gotta
record this.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Our lively party continues for some time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Is that all the fireworks we have?
Laaame.

text_block_list.text:

I can go check.
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'll go. Even though it's kind of a

Trainer, you're on bag carrying

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Hey, listen. You better be taking good
care of
City, 'kay?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
I know she acts all nonchalant about
everything,
but on the inside, she's a
delicate soul.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
At first, I liked her because I thought she
was
cool, but now I really care about
her. Seriously.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
When I'm with her, it's like... like it
makes me care
a little more about myself
too.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
But I'm too slow to figure out why City's
been
having a hard time. So, I can't
really help her.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: She might be too sweet to stand up for herself, but I'll do it—whatever that it is...
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's hard to put into words, but the
point is I
won't forgive you if you treat
her wrong!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: We'll see about that.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
choice_data_list: City is lucky to have such a kind friend.

text_block_list.text: Ew! You're so corny!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Whatever the case, Голд Сити seems to
have had
a nice break.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
